newsitem.title: JAPAN: FORECAST - Japan April leading index seen at 0.0.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Japan April leading index seen at 0.0.

text.p: Japan's diffusion index of leading economic indicators is expected to be 0.0 on a scale of 100 in April, while the index for coincident indicators is seen at 10.0, economists said on Wednesday.
The Economic Planning Agency is due to announce the data on Friday.

Economists said it would be the first time since August that coincident indicators have slipped under the so-called "boom or bust" mark of 50. A zero would mean that all of the components are expected to decline from the last period.
It would be the fourth month in a row that leading indicators have fallen below 50, they said.

They said April data would fall steeply due to very strong data in January, which saw healthy consumer demand ahead of a rise in the sales tax on April 1. The indices are compared with data three months earlier.
In March, the leading index stood at 30.0, while the coincident index stood at 80.0.
Economists said the indicators are likely to show improvements in May and thereafter as the impact of the consumption tax rise is likely to subside.
